supporting_pages.title: Data store hybrid agents \_|\_ Dialogflow CX \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: If you have an existing Dialogflow CX agent, you can upgrade this agent to a hybrid agent , which combines the power of precise conversation controls (flows, parameters, intents, conditions, transitions, and so on) with data store handler generative features.

As part of this upgrade, you may wish to delete or temporarily disable intent routes (while testing data store handlers) for certain conversation scenarios from your agent, because the data store handlers can handle those scenarios more simply.
